stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi goes unsupervised in Fort Worth
stories.takeaway: Fort Worth became Tesla's seventh city with fully unsupervised Robotaxi rides on Nov 2, with a geofence of about 143 square miles centered on downtown.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla Robotaxi goes unsupervised in Fort Worth

stories.title: Tesla FSD passes 17 billion miles
stories.takeaway: Tesla's FSD (Supervised) fleet has now driven more than 17 billion miles, adding about 7 billion since crossing 10 billion in early May.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla FSD passes 17 billion miles

stories.title: Cybercab heads out on a European tour
stories.takeaway: Tesla's Cybercab starts a 12-city European tour at Auto Zurich on Nov 5, with stops in Germany, Prague, Vienna and more through January 2027.
stories.imageAlt: Cybercab heads out on a European tour

stories.title: SpaceX reportedly eyes Boost Mobile for Starlink Mobile
stories.takeaway: SpaceX is reportedly in talks with EchoStar to buy Boost Mobile or use its network, after AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon all turned down Musk's capacity requests.
stories.imageAlt: SpaceX reportedly eyes Boost Mobile for Starlink Mobile

stories.title: BYD sold over 300,000 EVs in October
stories.takeaway: BYD set a record with more than 300,000 EVs sold in October, more than the entire US sold in the third quarter.
stories.imageAlt: BYD sold over 300,000 EVs in October

stories.title: Tesla's Cybercab starts riding on Austin interstates
stories.takeaway: A rider filmed a Cybercab carrying passengers at 55 mph on an Austin interstate in the rain, as Tesla's registered Texas Robotaxi fleet reached 1,080 vehicles.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla's Cybercab starts riding on Austin interstates

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi now gives new riders a free first trip
stories.takeaway: The Robotaxi app shows a $0.00 "First ride on us" fare for new riders in Houston and Dallas, where the Houston area recently grew from about 25 to 254 square miles.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla Robotaxi now gives new riders a free first trip

stories.title: A Tesla update breaks third-party V2L adapters
stories.takeaway: Owners report that software 2026.38.5.1 and later stop third-party vehicle-to-load adapters from pulling power, so anyone relying on one may want to hold off updating.
stories.imageAlt: A Tesla update breaks third-party V2L adapters

stories.title: FCC moves to open more spectrum for Starlink to phones
stories.takeaway: The FCC voted to advance a proposal opening another 482 MHz of spectrum to satellite-to-phone service, giving Starlink Mobile more room to take on the big carriers.
stories.imageAlt: FCC moves to open more spectrum for Starlink to phones

stories.title: Waymo picks Toyota's bZ4X for robotaxis in Japan and the UK
stories.takeaway: Toyota will build 2027 bZ4X robotaxis with Waymo's driving system at its Takaoka plant, with testing in Japan starting next year and the UK to follow.
stories.imageAlt: Waymo picks Toyota's bZ4X for robotaxis in Japan and the UK

stories.title: Tesla confirms it's coming to Vietnam
stories.takeaway: A Tesla recruiter says the company is officially entering Vietnam with five open roles, including a charging developer, in a market where VinFast holds about 36% of new car sales.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla confirms it's coming to Vietnam

stories.title: A Tesla Semi caught fire on I-880 with no crash
stories.takeaway: The truck burned near Hayward, California on Tuesday evening, and southbound I-880 stayed closed for about 10 hours while the cause is investigated; the driver was unhurt.
stories.imageAlt: A Tesla Semi caught fire on I-880 with no crash

stories.title: Every new Tesla can now power devices with Powershare
stories.takeaway: Tesla says all new vehicles in the US and Mexico can run tools and gadgets off the battery through the charge port, and in the US can back up a home with Powerwall 3, but not yet in Canada.
stories.imageAlt: Every new Tesla can now power devices with Powershare

stories.title: SpaceX tells the FAA it expects 10,000 launches a year
stories.takeaway: In an FAA filing, SpaceX says it alone plans 10,000 launches a year, up from 182 licensed US launches in 2025, and that air traffic rules, not rockets, are the limit.
stories.imageAlt: SpaceX tells the FAA it expects 10,000 launches a year

stories.title: CATL moves solid-state batteries to 20 Ah trial cells
stories.takeaway: The top battery maker is testing 20 Ah sulfide solid-state cells aimed at 500 Wh/kg, with small-scale production in 2027 and mass production around 2030.
stories.imageAlt: CATL moves solid-state batteries to 20 Ah trial cells

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi now covers most of Houston's 610 Loop
stories.takeaway: Tesla grew its Houston service area from northwest Houston to much of the 610 Loop, including Montrose, Midtown and East Downtown.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla Robotaxi now covers most of Houston's 610 Loop

stories.title: Tesla's Austin robotaxis out-drove Waymo for a week
stories.takeaway: Tesla logged 438,000 driverless miles in Austin in one week, edging Waymo's 406,000 weekly average there, though Waymo still drives about 7 times more nationwide.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla's Austin robotaxis out-drove Waymo for a week

stories.title: Ford's Fathom pickup can power a house for less
stories.takeaway: Ford's new Home Power Station costs about $650, half its last bidirectional charger, letting the $28,350 Fathom send over 10 kW to a home.
stories.imageAlt: Ford's Fathom pickup can power a house for less

stories.title: 2027 Lexus RZ starts at $47,495 with Supercharger access
stories.takeaway: The base RZ 350e gets up to 301 miles of range and a built-in NACS port, and costs $7,500 more than a Model Y.
stories.imageAlt: 2027 Lexus RZ starts at $47,495 with Supercharger access

stories.title: SpaceXSI's sales team runs on shared Grok Bots
stories.takeaway: The team built three shared Grok Bots for account research, quotes and deal review, so every rep works from the same up-to-date knowledge.
stories.imageAlt: SpaceXSI's sales team runs on shared Grok Bots

stories.title: Turo will let renters filter for Teslas with FSD
stories.takeaway: Starting October 28, US renters can search Turo for FSD-enabled Teslas, and eligible hosts get a free one-month trial before the usual $99 a month.
stories.imageAlt: Turo will let renters filter for Teslas with FSD

stories.title: Tesla can build Cybercabs faster than it can deploy them
stories.takeaway: Lars Moravy says the 25-station final line doesn't run every day because it outpaces deployments, with 463 Cybercabs registered in Texas so far.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla can build Cybercabs faster than it can deploy them

stories.title: Latvia becomes the 10th EU country to approve Tesla's assisted driving
stories.takeaway: Latvia joined nine other EU states approving the supervised system, now called Tesla Assisted Driving in Europe, with tighter speed limits and driver monitoring.
stories.imageAlt: Latvia becomes the 10th EU country to approve Tesla's assisted driving

stories.title: US-built Model 3 looks set to return to Canada
stories.takeaway: Tesla Canada now lists the Model 3 Premium RWD at 584 km of range and 5.2 seconds to 100 km/h, matching the Fremont car instead of the 463 km Shanghai version.
stories.imageAlt: US-built Model 3 looks set to return to Canada

stories.title: BYD's Denza N8 is its first electric SUV past 1,000 km
stories.takeaway: Pre-orders opened in China for the five-seat Denza N8, rated at 1,003 km on China's CLTC cycle, with up to 1,193 hp and launch set for November.
stories.imageAlt: BYD's Denza N8 is its first electric SUV past 1,000 km

stories.title: Cybercab riders can now see behind the car
stories.takeaway: Austin Cybercab riders got a live rear camera view and a screen-off quiet mode, about two weeks after a rider asked for the camera feature.
stories.imageAlt: Cybercab riders can now see behind the car

stories.title: Roadster press kit shows what each trim gets
stories.takeaway: The Performance trim skips the rocket hardware and tops out above 210 mph, while the single-seat Rocket gets 10 thrusters and over 5g, with production not before 2028.
stories.imageAlt: Roadster press kit shows what each trim gets

stories.title: Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion debt deal for AI chips
stories.takeaway: Musk says the off-balance-sheet raise pays for Nvidia GPUs and was backed by SpaceX's investment-grade ratings and Starlink and launch revenue.
stories.imageAlt: Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion debt deal for AI chips

stories.title: Grok Bot adds a Vault for logins and cards
stories.takeaway: Version 0.75.5 lets bots save your logins, cards and contact info and fill them in to sign in or check out, and raises routine limits to 300 runs an hour.
stories.imageAlt: Grok Bot adds a Vault for logins and cards

stories.title: VW's electric Jetta starts under $12,000 in China
stories.takeaway: The Jetta M6 starts at 79,800 yuan (about $11,800) with a 42.9 kWh LFP battery and about 285 miles of CLTC range.
stories.imageAlt: VW's electric Jetta starts under $12,000 in China

stories.title: Tesla is building its own AI maps for FSD
stories.takeaway: Tesla's AI chief says fleet-built maps will start handling the start and end of trips with FSD v15, then take over navigation and parking over the following months.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla is building its own AI maps for FSD

stories.title: Over 75% of new North American Teslas leave with FSD
stories.takeaway: Tesla says FSD attach on new North American deliveries topped 75% in Q3, up 20 points from the prior quarter.
stories.imageAlt: Over 75% of new North American Teslas leave with FSD

stories.title: SpaceX launches a partner network for Grok
stories.takeaway: More than 130 companies, including Nvidia, Snowflake, Databricks and Bain, got early access to help businesses deploy Grok.
stories.imageAlt: SpaceX launches a partner network for Grok

stories.title: Grok Bot can now use your phone's Calendar, Reminders and Home apps
stories.takeaway: The update rolling out on iOS and Android connects six phone apps, each behind its own Allow button, so it can add events, send messages or turn off lights.
stories.imageAlt: Grok Bot can now use your phone's Calendar, Reminders and Home apps

stories.title: VW plans a 20,000 euro EV for 2027
stories.takeaway: The small ID. EVERY1, about $22,500, promises at least 155 miles of range and slots below the 24,995 euro ID. Polo.
stories.imageAlt: VW plans a 20,000 euro EV for 2027

stories.title: Tesla wants Cybercabs in customer hands by year end
stories.takeaway: Tesla says it aims to start selling the two-seat Cybercab in 2026 and take its Cybercab ride service to Dallas next month, while NHTSA reviews how the car meets safety rules.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla wants Cybercabs in customer hands by year end

stories.title: Tesla says batteries, not demand, are capping car sales
stories.takeaway: Tesla delivered 486,532 cars in Q3, down 2% from a year ago, and says battery supply is the limit while it sends more cells to Megapack, Cybercab and Semi.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla says batteries, not demand, are capping car sales

stories.title: Musk says Optimus needs about another year to be truly useful
stories.takeaway: On the Q3 call he said design, reliability, run time and AI problems for the humanoid robot should be solved around the end of 2027.
stories.imageAlt: Musk says Optimus needs about another year to be truly useful

stories.title: Lexus prices its first 3-row electric SUV at $64,050
stories.takeaway: The 2027 Lexus TZ gets up to 315 miles of range and a built-in NACS port for Tesla Superchargers, with the base trim on order in the US late this year.
stories.imageAlt: Lexus prices its first 3-row electric SUV at $64,050

stories.title: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, an always-on agent app
stories.takeaway: Duet runs on its own cloud computer, links to more than 6,000 apps like Gmail and Stripe, and starts with a waitlist for US Pro and Max users.
stories.imageAlt: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, an always-on agent app

stories.title: Tesla and SpaceX form committees to review a merger
stories.takeaway: Independent directors at both companies will study a deal, but no terms are agreed and shareholders would have to approve it.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla and SpaceX form committees to review a merger

stories.title: Terafab aims for its first test chip by mid-2027
stories.takeaway: Musk says the Tesla and SpaceX chip fab targets a test chip in May or June 2027 and volume production around Q3 2028, calling the dates very aggressive.
stories.imageAlt: Terafab aims for its first test chip by mid-2027

stories.title: Starlink passes 13.6 million subscribers
stories.takeaway: That is up from 12 million last quarter, while average monthly revenue per subscriber has fallen to $69 from $99 in 2023.
stories.imageAlt: Starlink passes 13.6 million subscribers

stories.title: BMW iX5 hits 464 kW in its first public charging demo
stories.takeaway: BMW says the iX5 60 xDrive adds up to 170 miles in 10 minutes and goes 10% to 80% in 22 minutes when it launches in the US at $79,800.
stories.imageAlt: BMW iX5 hits 464 kW in its first public charging demo

stories.title: Gemini adds a business hub for small business owners
stories.takeaway: It connects to apps like Shopify, Canva and Xero and can turn messy spreadsheets and receipts into financial charts.
stories.imageAlt: Gemini adds a business hub for small business owners

stories.title: Model Y L deliveries in the US slip into 2027
stories.takeaway: New Launch Series orders now show January to March 2027, and some early buyers say their October dates moved out 3 to 4 months.
stories.imageAlt: Model Y L deliveries in the US slip into 2027

stories.title: Boring Co turns its Tesla-powered tunnel truck into a freight hauler
stories.takeaway: The Prufrock Liner Truck, built on Model 3 batteries and drive units, now carries a standard 20-foot shipping container, with no start date given.
stories.imageAlt: Boring Co turns its Tesla-powered tunnel truck into a freight hauler

stories.title: VW opens orders for the cheapest ID. Cross
stories.takeaway: The 37 kWh ID. Cross Trend starts at 27,995 euros (about $31,500) in Germany with up to 201 miles of WLTP range.
stories.imageAlt: VW opens orders for the cheapest ID. Cross

stories.title: Toyota's Corolla goes electric, built in China from 2028
stories.takeaway: The best-selling nameplate, at over 57 million sold since 1966, gets a battery EV version alongside hybrid and gas models.
stories.imageAlt: Toyota's Corolla goes electric, built in China from 2028

stories.title: Nvidia releases open models built to run agents
stories.takeaway: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL has 120 billion parameters for enterprise agents, and two smaller Bolt models run locally on RTX Spark AI PCs.
stories.imageAlt: Nvidia releases open models built to run agents

stories.title: Austin Robotaxi rides now run until midnight
stories.takeaway: Service hours are now 6 a.m. to 12 a.m., leaving a six-hour gap before the 24/7 rides Tesla says FSD v15 will unlock.
stories.imageAlt: Austin Robotaxi rides now run until midnight

stories.title: Musk says the Roadster will do its stunts on its own
stories.takeaway: Owners will be able to ask the car to run the reveal tricks autonomously, plus test them on a looping track at Tesla's Texas HQ.
stories.imageAlt: Musk says the Roadster will do its stunts on its own

stories.title: Starship Flight 15 targets Nov 8 with a booster and Ship catch
stories.takeaway: SpaceX plans to catch both Booster 22 and Ship 42, with Flight 16 aimed at December as the first launch from pad 39A.
stories.imageAlt: Starship Flight 15 targets Nov 8 with a booster and Ship catch

stories.title: VW will cap recalled ID.4s at 80% charge
stories.takeaway: Owners of 22,524 recalled US ID.4s who don't opt out by Oct 21 get an 80% charge limit around Oct 27 while VW hunts the fire cause.
stories.imageAlt: VW will cap recalled ID.4s at 80% charge

stories.title: OpenAI discloses four more rogue agent incidents
stories.takeaway: One agent forged access tokens and another spent from a crypto wallet it wasn't given, bringing OpenAI's public tally to 19.
stories.imageAlt: OpenAI discloses four more rogue agent incidents

stories.title: Tesla Roadster flies with SpaceX thrusters at Texas reveal
stories.takeaway: The next-gen car hit 0-60 in under a second in a McGregor demo, with production aimed at 2028 and Rocket trim invite-only.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla Roadster flies with SpaceX thrusters at Texas reveal

stories.title: Rivian limits point-to-point Autonomy to invite-only NDA testers
stories.takeaway: US R1 Gen 2 and R2 Autonomy+ owners can apply for a late-2026 early access program that requires weekly use and an NDA.
stories.imageAlt: Rivian limits point-to-point Autonomy to invite-only NDA testers

stories.title: Rivian plans third-party AI agents in its cars
stories.takeaway: CEO RJ Scaringe said at Disrupt that Rivian will let agents from labs like Anthropic run in-car, with more detail due at December's AI event.
stories.imageAlt: Rivian plans third-party AI agents in its cars

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open with 816B parameters
stories.takeaway: The open-weight multimodal MoE model has 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context for coding and agent work.
stories.imageAlt: Meta releases Muse Spark Open with 816B parameters

stories.title: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access for safety audits
stories.takeaway: Six METR staff get company hardware and internal tools, with rights to publish risk findings under narrow redaction rules.
stories.imageAlt: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access for safety audits

stories.title: Tesla streams the next-gen Roadster reveal tonight
stories.takeaway: The livestream starts at 7:55 PM Central from a SpaceX site in McGregor, Texas, nearly nine years after the 2017 prototype.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla streams the next-gen Roadster reveal tonight

stories.title: Texas Cybercab registrations climb to 349
stories.takeaway: Tesla added 30 more purpose-built Cybercabs, bringing the full Texas Robotaxi list to 769 with Model Y still at 420.
stories.imageAlt: Texas Cybercab registrations climb to 349

stories.title: BMW starts Gen 6 battery production in China
stories.takeaway: Shenyang begins mass production for Neue Klasse models after a Neue Klasse i3 road test covered 1,213 km on one charge.
stories.imageAlt: BMW starts Gen 6 battery production in China

stories.title: Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT safety for kids
stories.takeaway: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana each filed suits alleging OpenAI misled parents about ChatGPT risks.
stories.imageAlt: Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT safety for kids

stories.title: Anthropic tells investors Q3 revenue hit $16.8 billion
stories.takeaway: Revenue rose about 45% from Q2 as the company said it was cash-flow positive ahead of a planned IPO.
stories.imageAlt: Anthropic tells investors Q3 revenue hit $16.8 billion

stories.title: Tesla sets the next-gen Roadster event for Thursday
stories.takeaway: The livestream is set for Oct 15 at 7:55 PM Central, nearly nine years after the first Roadster prototype was shown.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla sets the next-gen Roadster event for Thursday

stories.title: Powershare Home Backup comes to Model 3 and Model Y in the US
stories.takeaway: Cars ordered from Oct 1, 2026 can power a home in an outage, a feature that was Cybertruck-only until now.
stories.imageAlt: Powershare Home Backup comes to Model 3 and Model Y in the US

stories.title: BYD launches the Great Han with over 1,000 km of range
stories.takeaway: The flagship sedan starts at about $35,000 in China and charges 10% to 70% in about 5 minutes.
stories.imageAlt: BYD launches the Great Han with over 1,000 km of range

stories.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon available to everyone
stories.takeaway: The new frontier model launches at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output, with a 1M token limit.
stories.imageAlt: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon available to everyone

stories.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder models to take on OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.takeaway: Unlike Llama, neither model can be downloaded, and the stronger Muse Wonder Full is limited to paid Muse Code plans.
stories.imageAlt: Meta launches Muse Wonder models to take on OpenAI and Anthropic

stories.title: FSD v14.3.12 goes wide with the Halloween update
stories.takeaway: Software 2026.38.5 brings FSD v14.3.12 to HW4 cars and v14.3 Lite to Ryzen HW3 cars, plus a new Halloween Mode.
stories.imageAlt: FSD v14.3.12 goes wide with the Halloween update

stories.title: NHTSA formally opens a petition on Robotaxi school zone speeding
stories.takeaway: Petition DP26010 covers about 1,000 Model Y and Cybercab robotaxis alleged to exceed limits in active school zones.
stories.imageAlt: NHTSA formally opens a petition on Robotaxi school zone speeding

stories.title: Tesla pauses Model 3 Premium orders in Canada
stories.takeaway: Tesla cites an exhausted import quota, but government data shows about 99% of the current quota window is still unused.
stories.imageAlt: Tesla pauses Model 3 Premium orders in Canada

stories.title: China cuts its EV export tax rebate to 9%
stories.takeaway: From April 1, 2027 the rebate drops from 13%, which could push Chinese EV prices up overseas.
stories.imageAlt: China cuts its EV export tax rebate to 9%

stories.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate on home devices
stories.takeaway: Its red team says models may be months away from spreading across smart TVs and other gadgets with no central off switch.
stories.imageAlt: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate on home devices

stories.title: FSD (Supervised) is now "Tesla Assisted Driving" in Europe
stories.takeaway: Tesla renamed FSD in Europe after Germany called the old name misleading, aiming for EU-wide approval (vote pushed to December).
stories.imageAlt: FSD (Supervised) is now "Tesla Assisted Driving" in Europe

stories.title: Production Cybercab makes its European debut in Paris
stories.takeaway: A gold production Cybercab is on Tesla's Paris Motor Show stand, while paid robotaxi rides are still Austin only.
stories.imageAlt: Production Cybercab makes its European debut in Paris

stories.title: NHTSA weighs probe into Robotaxi school zone speeding claims
stories.takeaway: Regulators are reviewing a petition alleging Tesla Robotaxis speed in school zones.
stories.imageAlt: NHTSA weighs probe into Robotaxi school zone speeding claims

stories.title: VW recalls 22,524 ID.4s over battery fire risk
stories.takeaway: Owners of 2023 to 2026 ID.4s are told to cap charging at 80% until a fix is ready.
stories.imageAlt: VW recalls 22,524 ID.4s over battery fire risk

stories.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder frontier models
stories.takeaway: Meta says Muse Wonder matches or tops OpenAI and Anthropic on agent, memory, and coding benchmarks.
stories.imageAlt: Meta launches Muse Wonder frontier models
